facts.fact: Switch Al Maghrib says membership of its national card and mobile switch requires a Bank Al-Maghrib licence and Bank Al-Maghrib's opinion on each application, and that its financial security mechanisms are validated by Bank Al-Maghrib.
Switch Al Maghrib says payment institutions and e-money institutions licensed by Bank Al-Maghrib, as well as banks, may apply to join its switch.

MAR.note: No connection rule stated; the page describes conditions of membership.

facts.fact: Switch Al Maghrib describes itself as the national routing, clearing and settlement infrastructure for card and mobile transactions, giving members access to all card and mobile switch members, and reports 1,826,316 mobile switch transactions in 2025.

MAR.note: Whether it covers both wallets and bank accounts for all uses is not stated beyond membership by banks and payment institutions.
